page: Microsoft Azure D16ps_v7 is a general purpose virtual machine instance running on Microsoft Hyper-V. The system is provisioned with 16 dedicated virtual CPUs built on the 64-bit ARM architecture (arm64). Compute resources are coupled with 64.0 GB of RAM, establishing a standard memory-to-core ratio of 4.0 GB per vCPU. The instance does not include graphical processing units (0 GPUs).

Local physical storage is absent on the instance, requiring all operating system and application data to reside on attached remote volumes. The configuration is capable of utilizing Premium Storage for managed disk operations. Networking does not include complimentary public IPv4 addresses, necessitating virtual network configuration or gateway assignment for public internet access.

The 64-bit ARM hardware platform provides resource density for multi-threaded systems while optimizing operational efficiency relative to conventional x86 hardware. The server is structured for general enterprise deployments, including containerized microservices, build and CI/CD pipelines, web application serving, and mid-tier backend databases that support ARM64 execution.
